svg.font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', 'IBM Plex Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace
svg.title: signer — architecture
svg.desc: Everything the signer module needs from outside arrives through four injected ports (storage, transport, clock, crypto); the module owns no environment and touches no browser global, no relay, no extension and no OS keychain. Bands top to bottom: the outside world; the consumer's side, which does not exist yet; the ports, the only door in; the module interior; what it guarantees and does not ship. The legend sits below the lowest boundary.

g.text: 1 · the outside world — none of this is reachable from inside the module
the far side of the NIP-46
2 · the consumer's side — nothing in this band exists yet
the future consumer — DOES NOT EXIST YET
A marketplace app, or a CLI that builds a signer from a key with no session.
Nothing imports this module. The market's 90 .sign( call sites are the checklist
waiting for whoever wires it — and this build does not wire it.
the host's relay layer: a pool,
the host's timers, so that a
test and in a real host
None of these four adapters exists in this build: the module ships no host implementation of any port.
3 · the ports — the only door in: everything environmental arrives here, and nothing else
+ the same seam carries two more injected values as plain arguments: the NIP-07 extension object, and the passphrase source.
4 · inside the module — it owns no environment
isolation, measured over all 15 .ts files in signer/ts: 0 × localStorage · sessionStorage · indexedDB · window. · document. · navigator. · React · @nostr-dev-kit · @/
index.ts — the public entry: the contract's surface
createSignerSession(deps) · createSignerFromKey(material) · the 13 operations · the 13 typed refusals
24 value exports (13 typed refusals + the 5 record constants) · 27 type exports — nothing else
refused: active without a resolved identity
refused: a second capability while one is attached
the identity is learned only through getPublicKey()
every event is re-verified and its pubkey compared
nip04/nip44 offered only if the signer has it AND
the composer's allow-list permits it — else refuse
no session is ever stored in the clear, ever
floor: 100k iterations accepted, below that refused
a legacy plaintext record: migrate once, or re-login
13 typed refusals over one base SignerError
no bare strings, no silent fallback anywhere
bunker:// · nostrconnect:// — both need transport + clock
an ncryptsec signer that is locked rejects fast, never hangs
the extension is an argument: the module reads no window.*
strict bind: a bare 'ack' is dropped, the secret must match (I1)
the remote signer's key stays separate from the identity (I2)
every RPC is bounded by the injected clock: 30s RPC, 5min connect
the secret travels in secret=, never in token=
a legacy token-only URI is refused
the URI goes to the caller's own callback
it carries the secret, so it never enters a snapshot
5 · what it guarantees — the five invariants
5b · what it does NOT ship, yet
and this build left it so
the consumer's side — adapters, the future consumer
fail-closed: the door, the refusals, the guarantees
the outside world — never reached by the module
solid = a call the module makes / an implementation
rose dashed = a fail-closed refusal path
amber dashed = declared, not yet exercised
✕ the module never reaches the outside world
the outside world stops at the consumer's territory
